paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Present Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: μι-verbs: no theme vowel — endings sit straight on the stem, long δω- in the singular, short δο- in the plural. δι- is present reduplication.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Present Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: Like δίδωμι, with θη-/θε- alternation. The reduplication is τι- (θι- would break Grassmann's law of aspirates).

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Present Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: The reduplication ἱ- hides an old σι- (σι-στη → ἱστη): that is why it carries the rough breathing. H&Q marks the imperfect's augment only by vowel LENGTH (ῑ), so several imperfect forms print identically to the present.

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Imperfect Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: The singular substitutes thematic contracted forms (ἐδίδουν < *ἐδίδοον); the plural is honest athematic διδο- (§100 obs. 3).

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Imperfect Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: 1st singular athematic ἐτίθην, but 2nd/3rd singular thematic ἐτίθεις, ἐτίθει (< *ἐτίθεες, *ἐτίθεε — §100 obs. 2).

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Imperfect Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: The augment hides inside the long ῑ-: 2nd singular and both 1st/2nd plural print identically to the present — only vowel length (unmarked here) tells them apart.

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Present Middle/Passive Indicative
paradigms.notes: Middle/passive athematic endings on the short stem διδο-; the -σ- of -σαι stays even between vowels.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Present Middle/Passive Indicative
paradigms.notes: Middle/passive athematic endings on the short stem τιθε-.

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Present Middle/Passive Indicative
paradigms.notes: Middle/passive athematic endings on ἱστα-; the imperfect middle prints identically in the 1st/2nd plural.

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Imperfect Middle/Passive Indicative
paradigms.notes: Augment + short stem + the same endings the pluperfect middle/passive uses.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Imperfect Middle/Passive Indicative
paradigms.notes: Augment + short stem τιθε- + secondary middle endings.

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Imperfect Middle/Passive Indicative
paradigms.notes: Only the (unwritten) length of the initial ῑ separates these from the present middle/passive — the 1st/2nd plural print identically.

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Present Active Subjunctive
paradigms.notes: Short stem + long subjunctive endings, contracted (ο + η/ω — §100.5: ο+ῃ gives ῳ, NOT οι). 3rd singular active and 2nd singular middle/passive are one form.

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Present M/P Subjunctive
paradigms.notes: Short stem + long subjunctive endings, contracted (ο + η/ω — §100.5: ο+ῃ gives ῳ, NOT οι). 3rd singular active and 2nd singular middle/passive are one form.

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Present Active Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν.

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Present M/P Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Present Active Subjunctive
paradigms.notes: Short stem + long subjunctive endings, contracted (ε + η/ω — §100.5: ο+ῃ gives ῳ, NOT οι). 3rd singular active and 2nd singular middle/passive are one form.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Present M/P Subjunctive
paradigms.notes: Short stem + long subjunctive endings, contracted (ε + η/ω — §100.5: ο+ῃ gives ῳ, NOT οι). 3rd singular active and 2nd singular middle/passive are one form.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Present Active Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Present M/P Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν. τίθημι also has thematic alternates (τιθοῖτο…).

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Present Active Subjunctive
paradigms.notes: Short stem + long subjunctive endings, contracted (ε + η/ω — §100.5: ο+ῃ gives ῳ, NOT οι). 3rd singular active and 2nd singular middle/passive are one form. Note the subjunctive stem is ἱστε-, NOT ἱστα- (§100 obs. 2).

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Present M/P Subjunctive
paradigms.notes: Short stem + long subjunctive endings, contracted (ε + η/ω — §100.5: ο+ῃ gives ῳ, NOT οι). 3rd singular active and 2nd singular middle/passive are one form.

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Present Active Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν.

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Present M/P Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν.
